title: DAGOS Jev Context Classification v1
description: Jev's entire output: one classification label per node, and optionally per tool. Jev only classifies context membership, so the contract has no room for plans, routes, provider choices, tool calls, actions, or prose. Each node_id must be a candidate from the request and appear at most once; candidates Jev leaves out keep their current membership.

classification.description: active: the node belongs in the run's active context. inactive: it does not; the durable node is unaffected.

tools.description: Which candidate tools the model sees in this run: active exposes a tool, inactive hides it. Each name must be a tool candidate from the request, at most once; tools left out stay exposed.
